_comment: Sanitized REAL dsh-web agentPreset.list capture (dsh web 0.0.1, live 2026-08-28, G4 sample-gate evidence). Field names/types/order are verbatim from the live /api/agentPreset.list response. Preset ids/names/descriptions/trust/isDefault are official product strings kept verbatim (no user data); rpcId replaced with a fixture value. authorable/hasDocument are live top-level fields NOT pinned in the MacBridge agentPresetListValue struct (decode-tolerant, documented here).
